verdict.rationale: Docs show Pydantic AI's core output_type mechanism forces model responses to match a Pydantic schema (docs-6/18/28), and the framework is built around retry-capable structured output. However, multiple hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliability: one developer found structured output 'rarely' worked 'regardless of the number of retries' compared to a raw OpenAI SDK call (pydantic-ai-comm-6), and another reports LLMs frequently refusing to supply conforming JSON 'even with several retries configured' (pydantic-ai-comm-10), with the maintainer attributing failures to third-party API/tool-calling inconsistencies rather than denying the issue (pydantic-ai-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party docs snippet explicitly describing the retry/validation-error feedback loop, and independent corroboration that retries reliably resolve validation failures across providers.
